```yaml
name: PR Title Check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  pre-job:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Pre-job placeholder
        run: echo "Pre-job completed"

  validate-pr-title:
    name: Validate PR Title
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: pre-job
    steps:
      - name: Check PR title
        uses: amannn/action-semantic-pull-request@v6
        with:
          types: feat,fix,chore
          requireScope: false
          subjectPattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9 ]+$
          subjectPatternError: "Subject must be lowercase"
          validateSingleCommit: true
          validateSingleCommitMatchesPrTitle: true
          githubBaseUrl: ${{ github.server_url }}
          ignoreLabels: skip-pr-title-check
```
